title: File record
description: One stored document or export, described by the handle it is fetched with, who owns it, and how it is encrypted at rest. Matches web/app/data-templates/fileRecord.json. DocVault (SYS-14) holds the correspondence archive and retrieval takes two to four minutes per document during a call, so the handle is recorded once and reused. POST /api/files rejects a body that fails these rules, and /form/file imports the same file to show errors before submit.
x-standards: NIST SP 800-38D AES-GCM and RFC 8439 ChaCha20-Poly1305
ISO/IEC 27001 asset ownership and information classification
x-invariants: handle.checksum.value is the digest of the stored bytes under handle.checksum.algorithm, lowercase hex, and its length matches that algorithm.
When encryption.encrypted is true, algorithm is a cipher, keyId is a key reference, and encryptedAt is a date.
When encryption.encrypted is false, algorithm is None, keyId is an empty string, and encryptedAt is null.
ownership.retentionUntil is on or after createdDate.
When lastAccessedDate is a date, it is on or after createdDate.
Every access grant's expiresDate is null or on or after its grantedDate.
A Restricted or Confidential file is encrypted.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: How the bytes are found and checked. The URI is the retrieval handle; the checksum is what proves the fetched copy is the recorded one.

uri.title: Handle URI
uri.description: RFC 3986 absolute URI the bytes are fetched with. https for a gateway, s3 for object storage, dv for a DocVault archive reference.

systemId.title: Held in
systemId.description: Northwind system the bytes live in. SYS-14 is DocVault, the customer document and correspondence archive. Codes come from northwind_systems.csv.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Name shown to a person, with an extension. No path separators: the path belongs in the URI.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: IANA media type of the stored bytes. Type and subtype only; no parameters.

sizeBytes.title: Size in bytes
sizeBytes.description: Stored size in whole bytes, counted after encryption.

checksum.title: Checksum
checksum.description: Digest of the stored bytes. SHA-256 is the default; SHA-1 appears only on records migrated from the 2005 archive.

value.title: Digest value
value.description: Lowercase hex digest: 40 characters for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256, 128 for SHA-512.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: Who the file belongs to, which Northwind function is accountable for it, and how long it is kept. ISO/IEC 27001 asset owner plus information classification.

ownerId.title: Owner
ownerId.description: Identifier of the owning principal, in the prefix form its type uses: ACC- for a customer, EMP- for an employee, CON- for a contractor, SYS- for a system.

ownerName.title: Owner name
ownerName.description: Person or organisation the identifier belongs to.

owningFunction.title: Accountable function
owningFunction.description: Northwind function accountable for the file. Values are the owning functions in northwind_systems.csv.

accountId.title: Account
accountId.description: Customer account the file is filed against, or an empty string when it is not customer correspondence.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Handling class. Confidential and Restricted files must be encrypted.

retentionUntil.title: Keep until
retentionUntil.description: Date the file may be destroyed. On or after createdDate.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: How the bytes are protected at rest. Unencrypted records state that explicitly rather than leaving the block blank.

algorithm.title: Cipher
algorithm.description: Authenticated cipher used, or None when the file is stored in the clear.

keyId.title: Key reference
keyId.description: Reference to the key, never the key itself. Empty string when the file is not encrypted.

encryptedAt.title: Encrypted on
encryptedAt.description: Date the stored copy was encrypted, or null when it is not encrypted.

access.title: Access grants
access.description: Who may do what with the file. An empty array means only the owner and the accountable function.

createdDate.title: Stored on
createdDate.description: Date the file was put into the archive.

lastAccessedDate.title: Last opened
lastAccessedDate.description: Date the file was last retrieved, or null when it has not been opened since it was stored.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Anything a later reader needs, such as the migration it arrived in. Empty string when there is nothing to add.

FileId.title: File identifier
FileId.description: Identifier of the archive record. Form FILE- plus six digits, parallel to ACC-, BILL-, and NW-.

SystemId.title: Northwind system
SystemId.description: System code from northwind_systems.csv, SYS-01 through SYS-15.

PrincipalId.title: Principal identifier
PrincipalId.description: Customer, employee, contractor, or system identifier. Prefix follows the principal type.

oneOf.description: An ACC- account holder.
An EMP- member of staff.
A CON- service firm.
A SYS- system acting on its own behalf, such as a nightly export.
May be published.
Northwind staff and contractors.

128 hex characters.

Stored in the clear. Only for Public and Internal files.
NIST SP 800-38D. Default for new records.
NIST SP 800-38D.

Keys never leave an HSM.

KeyId.title: Key reference
KeyId.description: Opaque handle for the key. Form KEY- plus four to twelve uppercase hex characters. Never a key value.

expiresDate.title: Expires on
expiresDate.description: Date the grant lapses, or null for a standing grant.

oneOf.description: Fetch the bytes.
Replace the bytes with a new version.
Destroy the record before its retention date.
Grant access to a further principal.
